options.how: Hired heroes keep fighting while you are away, so gold piles up between sessions.
Candies accrue on a per-second page timer only while the game is open; closing it simply pauses everything.

sources.note: Clicker Heroes: your heroes never quit, even when you do, so gold piles up while you sleep
Candy Box!: official hosted game; production runs on in-page setInterval timers with no offline catch-up

options.how: The kingdom keeps earning wealth while you are not online, so short check-ins collect long stretches of income.
Villager income and population grow on in-game timers that tick only while the game is running.

sources.note: Realm Grinder: grow a realm that earns wealth even while you're not online
A Dark Room: official source; income is collected by a one-second in-game timer, no offline calculation

options.how: Combines active runs with offline progression, so returning players find banked progress.
Stores and the village only advance while the page runs; stepping away pauses the world.

sources.note: Idle Slayer: deep idle RPG with active and offline progression
A Dark Room: official source; timers drive income only while the game runs

options.how: Offline baking is earned: the Twin Gates heavenly upgrade keeps baking at 5% CpS while closed, more with later upgrades.
Clips, funds and projects advance on in-page ticks; closing the tab pauses the factory with no catch-up.

sources.note: Cookie Clicker: Twin Gates of Transcendence keeps making cookies while closed at 5% CpS
Universal Paperclips: official game code runs on setInterval ticks with no offline progress calculation

options.how: A 400-day real-time countdown keeps running even after you exit the game; you can simply come back later.
Growth happens only while the page is open, so attention during play drives every phase.

sources.note: The Longing: the game counts down the 400 days even when you stop playing and exit
Universal Paperclips: official game code, tick-based loop without offline catch-up

options.how: Ascending resets the bakery for prestige levels (+1% CpS each) and heavenly chips spent on permanent upgrades.
One climb through narrative phases, from clip business to Earth to space, with no resets along the way.

sources.note: Cookie Clicker: ascension grants prestige levels and heavenly chips, +1% CpS per level
Universal Paperclips: official game page

note: Universal Paperclips offers an optional new-universe restart with a small bonus only after the ending; the main game has no prestige loop.

options.how: No prestige by design: 20+ skills level up in one continuous save that never resets.
Reaching Infinity resets production for Infinity Points spent on permanent upgrades, with further prestige layers beyond.

sources.note: Melvor Idle: no prestige system, the developer is not in favour of them
Antimatter Dimensions: multiple layers of prestige, reach Infinity for Infinity points

options.how: One continuous adventure: candies, gear and unlocked areas carry forward and are never traded in for a reset.
Ascension resets all progress for Hero Souls that buy Ancients with permanent power.

sources.note: Candy Box!: official hosted game; the code has no prestige or reset loop
Clicker Heroes: Ascension, the big reset that trades all progress for Hero Souls and permanent power

options.how: A single 400-day wait for the king to wake; the save is one unrepeated stretch, not a reset loop.
Repeated prestiges restart the farm for lasting boosts, with a nested prestige system layered on top.

sources.note: The Longing: the king sleeps 400 days; come back after 400 days to see how it ends
Egg, Inc.: balance strategies through many prestiges, nested prestige system

options.how: Progress is permanent: skill levels and the bank only ever grow, so long-term goals are caps, not resets.
Reincarnations reset the realm to unlock new factions and systems over months of content.

sources.note: Melvor Idle: no prestige system planned
Realm Grinder: unlock new factions, research, reincarnations

options.how: Points come only from your own key presses and clicks while it runs on the taskbar; walk away and nothing is earned.
Production keeps running while you are away, so offline progress is waiting on return alongside automation.

sources.note: Bongo Cat: every time you press a key, Bongo Cat punches your taskbar; type, click, play and work to collect points and hat drops
Revolution Idle: idle incremental with offline progress, keep gaining while you're away; prestige layers and automation

options.how: No offline income by design: the developer pitches it as a short, intense run of active play with replayable builds.
An offline bonus replays the progress made while the game was closed the next time you launch it.

sources.note: Idle Colony: developer reply, no offline income is the design intention; a short intense active experience
Your Chronicle: offline bonus allows progress made when the game is closed to be reproduced at launch

options.how: Candies and quests tick on in-page timers only while the tab is open; there is no catch-up for time spent away.
Your village keeps earning gold even while you are offline, so returning players spend a banked sum on upgrades.

sources.note: Candy Box 2: official hosted game; candybox2.js runs on setInterval timers and only uses Date to label saves, so nothing accrues while closed
Tap Ninja: build up your village to earn even more gold even while you are offline

options.how: Progress needs the game open: the developer rejects offline income, framing it as a short, active colony build.
Fish grow in real time and ticket income keeps paying out as offline earnings while the game is closed.

sources.note: Idle Colony: developer says no offline income is not the design intention; active gameplay
Chillquarium: raise fish in real time, sell them or earn money through ticket sales
Chillquarium 1.3.7 Hotfix B: fixed a bug where some users were not getting offline earnings

options.how: Points from key presses roll hat and skin drops into a permanent inventory; nothing ever resets.
Short runs bust nodes for resources spent on a big upgrade tree, with prestige levels (up to 25) layered on top.

sources.note: Bongo Cat: every time you press a key, Bongo Cat punches your taskbar; type, click, play and work to collect points and hat drops

options.how: A single adventure save: candies buy gear, quests open new places, and the story ends without any reset layer.

sources.note: Candy Box 2: official hosted game; candybox2.js runs on setInterval timers and only uses Date to label saves, so nothing accrues while closed

sources.note: Chillquarium: progress from a simple starter tank to your dream setup; complete a collection of 156 fish
Unnamed Space Idle: progression and prestige; prestige unlocks different ships, weapons, defenses and utilities

options.how: A desktop sticker: the frog cuts grass you spend on tools, better grass and decorations until the island collection is complete.
Gnorps strike the rock for shards to buy more gnorps and structures, and a prestige resets the build so the next one can push further.

options.how: A farm strip at the bottom of the screen: crops become biofuel money that buys more robots and land, in one continuous expansion.

sources.note: Rusty's Retirement: idle-farming at the bottom of your screen; sell biofuel and reinvest in robots and expanding your farm

options.how: Nothing resets: cut grass buys tool upgrades and island buildings and plants, and the goal is to own every item.

sources.note: Ropuka's Idle Island: unlock new buildings and plants, can you get every item and complete the collection
Farmer Against Potatoes Idle: Reincarnate for bigger permanent bonuses; 6 classes with talent trees

options.how: Plant, water and harvest with upgradable helper bots; the farm only ever grows, with no reset for a multiplier.

sources.note: Rusty's Retirement: deploy robots to plant, water and harvest; customize and upgrade helper bots; expand your farm
Increlution: death marks a new beginning; progress in previous lives increases your instincts

options.how: Buy baby animals, raise them and collect their coins to expand the pasture and unlock species, in one long climb.
Ascend to trade your run for permanent Skill Upgrades, then rebuild village and gold faster on the next pass.
